reviews.title: Fantastic case
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/B1GTM-YAQoL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/618xVww89vL._SY256.jpg This is my first time using a product from this company. I researched for months for my build which is the top of the line everything. I didn’t want to skimp on the case, I wanted a case where I could hide the psu and cables easily. I wanted a case with a unique fan appearance if possible, I actually didn’t think it was possible. After much consideration I chose this case, the fact the reviews all mention high quality materials, glass, arrangement and fans was a big factor in my decision.
The good
-This case is large, perfect for a build that includes the 9950x3d cpu and a 5090 gpu. Plenty of space for everything without being cramped.
-this case comes with one or four fans. I would like to have had the option of 7 fans but getting 4 is still a bonus compared to most other cases.
-this case comes in white or black, and the fans match. I was going to do a white build but lack of available parts in white and the fact I really liked this cases looks black, caused me to lean towards the black version.
-the layout is perfect. It has a place to mount the psu sideways so you can easily access your psu plugs and cables. It has routing ties and plenty of access holes to route anything, anywhere. It has room for a single 120 fan on the back, 3 on bottom, side and top which is a total of 10 fans. This allows for easy fan and/or radiator installation as well as utilizing directional fans so you have bottom and side pulling in cold air and the back and top putting out hot air.
- additional facts on the psu mount. The fact the psu is mounted in a separate section not only allows it to pull in cold air from the side but also prevents hot air from going into the case. This is a legit problem with cases where the psu is in the primary section on the bottom of the case. The cables excess wiring is able to be kept in this section, out of sight and also not hindering air flow for the components. This is a huge plus for rigs that produce heat like mine does.
-motherboard mount is simple, and allows cables from all components to run behind the motherboard in the separate section so again, no wire clutter to look at or reduce heat dissipation. You only use a few inches to plug into the motherboard. There are access holes all the way around so you route the cables in the separate section and only bring in enough of the wire to effectively plug it in. This is the cleanest install I ever experienced and I have built a lot of rigs in the past 24 years.
-the fans are unique not only in their look but they also utilize a proprietary connection method. This may make some people nervous but for complex high end builds, this is yet another bonus feature that shows how much engineering went into this case. The fans connect to one another using a plate to plate method, the final fan has the wires to plug into the motherboard or controller. The rgb lights on these fans are also unique in their design, utilizing clean lines but also the mirrored sides. When you see these fans you can’t help but exclaim “wow” because with the organization that you get from this case, the fans can be seen in all their glory. No wires blocking the view what so ever. The rgb control is easy to use and easily combined with all other lighting on the pc.
-another bonus feature many might miss seeing is the fact they include a gpu support, that is adjustable and is built into the case. This is huge for cards like the 5090. Simple, effective, absolutely fantastic. Just another way you can see the engineering that went into this creation of this case.
-filters, this is something becoming common so it’s not unexpected but they do have them for all incoming air locations which many cases still lack. The bonus feature is how easily they can be removed and cleaned without dismantling anything.
-access to the panels is excellent, they have thumb screws on every panel but also the glass is plug mounted on the front edge. So it pops off easily. You have easy access to every section via panels for front, top and back side. The thumb screws can unscrew entirely if you can leave them in the panel when they release from the case. This prevents losing if the said screws, another nice bonus feature that seems small.
Many of the features I mentioned may seem small but they are not insignificant by any stretch. When you put them all together then you have much less of a headache being possibly caused by something small going wrong. I know I’m repeating myself here but with this case you can tell how much thought went into engineering every detail even the small ones that alone seem insignificant. They really focused on the little things here and I can appreciate that as a builder. I will absolutely purchase from this company again in the future.
Note: I did need to contact the company to find the reverse fans for this case. The responded quickly and advised me how to obtain the fans I needed. They were eager to learn why thoughts I might have had about the case and fans, I imagine this is because when they design the next case, much like this case, they want to focus on the details that matter. So gaining my input helps them be more effective on the next design. I respect that from a company.
As always if I encounter anything good or bad from this point on, I will come update my review accordingly. :-). No builder can go wrong with this case and dare I say, this company. I can’t wait to build my next rig, maybe I can do the white build soon.
reviews.author: Sage B

reviews.title: Dual Liquid AIO Coolers - Fit!
reviews.comment:
First, the only downside: it doesn’t come with a vertical GPU mount kit, and I couldn’t find an official one online. Also, the case is a bit cheaper now than when I bought it. That said - everything else about this case is awesome. I chose the DY470 not only for the 310° view, excellent cable management, “angles on angles” design, and the crazy leg-mounted USB ports, but also for its superb airflow, generous working space, and vert-mount capability. The real surprise? It can fit two liquid AIO radiators. I searched forever for a case with BTF support (even though I opted for a reg ATX mobo), vertical mounting options, and room for two triple-fan AIOs - and this one delivered (see pics).
I grabbed a simple vertical-mount faceplate, a GPU sag support, and the floating look is sic. The CPU cooler hoses are almost completely hidden behind the GPU while still running to the bottom of the radiator for the ideal 2nd mounting position. I also added DIY mesh screens to the back panel (see pic) and they work flawlessly. All in all, I’m extremely happy with the Darkflash DY470. This case absolutely rocks!

reviews.title: Beautiful case!
reviews.comment: I love this case! This is the first time I have used this brand and I couldn't be happier with it! Large case with tons of room. You will not be disappointed with this one at all. Build quality is amazing, cable management is easy with this one. Tons and tons of airflow, no more over heating and it holds multiple radiators! Noise level is what you make it with how many fans you have installed! For the quality, this thing is cheap.
reviews.author: John Mix

reviews.title: GREAT CASE
reviews.comment: I purchased the darkFlash Full-Tower ATX Gaming PC Case with egg fans. This case is very nice quality. The size of it is perfect for practically any setup. I love the power supply location as well and the usb, headphone, and mic plug location. I’m currently running an MSI mag motherboard, with a RTX 5070ti gpu. I also added a water cooled system and 3 more fans at the bottom of the case. There was plenty of room for all of this with ease. I use this pc daily and love the way it looks. I had one small issue with a fan. Amazon and Dark Flash were very helpful and prompt in addressing the issue. The third party seller wasn’t very helpful at all and actually tried to avoid helping. Once Amazon and Dark Flash got involved it was all addressed. Over all I would absolutely recommend this case and brand.

reviews.title: Well worth the money and effort
reviews.comment:

Spacious, manufacturing is clean, well worth the money. The factory fans run quiet and there’s 10 of them in mine. Airflow is fantastic and was easy to put all my parts in due to the extra space.
